tierExplainer.summary: What's the difference between Peers and Coaches?
tierExplainer.peerBody: Anyone with real experience can sign up. Ideal if you just want to chat with someone in your industry or an interesting background and hear first-hand experience.
tierExplainer.peerReqs: Verification: identity, education & work experience review
tierExplainer.mentorBody: For those seeking specific help — structured career planning, guidance and professional coaching. Coach cards carry a crown badge.
tierExplainer.mentorReqs: Verification: everything Peer needs + professional coaching certificates + a ~20-min 1v1 interview
